import csv
import re
from decimal import Decimal

# Data extracted from PDFs
invoices = {
    '002071': {
        'vendor': 'Delta Studio Supply',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Archive cartons, reinforced - batch 2', 'qty': '9', 'unit_price': '12.45', 'amount': '112.05'},
            {'description': 'Labels "Handle with care", roll 2', 'qty': '3', 'unit_price': '10.80', 'amount': '32.40'},
            {'description': 'Cut-to-length protective liner, grade 2', 'qty': '2.5', 'unit_price': '14.76', 'amount': '36.90'},
            {'description': 'Returned labels credit, order 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-9.80', 'amount': '-9.80'},
        ],
        'tax': '22.17',
        'total': '193.72'
    },
    '002082': {
        'vendor': 'Elm Fabrication Ltd',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Bench assembly, series 2', 'qty': '2', 'unit_price': '1262.60', 'amount': '2525.20'},
            {'description': 'Alignment service, station 2', 'qty': '1.5', 'unit_price': '86.40', 'amount': '129.60'},
            {'description': 'Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 2, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', 'qty': '3', 'unit_price': '49.75', 'amount': '149.25'},
            {'description': 'Precision shims, pack 2', 'qty': '7', 'unit_price': '4.375', 'amount': '30.63'},
            {'description': 'Freight and handling, zone 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '42.50', 'amount': '42.50'},
            {'description': 'Volume discount, agreement 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-36.00', 'amount': '-36.00'},
        ],
        'tax': '154.28',
        'total': '2995.46'
    },
    '002093': {
        'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Site survey, area 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '448.50', 'amount': '448.50'},
            {'description': 'Travel time, route 2', 'qty': '2.25', 'unit_price': '64.80', 'amount': '145.80'},
            {'description': 'Calibration standard, set 2', 'qty': '2', 'unit_price': '37.25', 'amount': '74.50'},
            {'description': 'Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', 'qty': '4', 'unit_price': '18.95', 'amount': '75.80'},
            {'description': 'Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', 'qty': '5', 'unit_price': '11.40', 'amount': '57.00'},
            {'description': 'Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-26.00', 'amount': '-26.00'},
        ],
        'tax': '90.64',
        'total': '866.26'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = data['vendor']
        for item in data['items']:
            writer.writerow([
                invoice_id,
                vendor,
                item['description'],
                item['qty'],
                item['unit_price'],
                item['amount']
            ])

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        # Calculate subtotal from line items
        subtotal = sum(Decimal(item['amount']) for item in data['items'])
        tax = Decimal(data['tax'])
        printed_total = Decimal(data['total'])
        computed_total = subtotal + tax
        difference = computed_total - printed_total
        
        status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
        
        writer.writerow([
            invoice_id,
            f'{subtotal:.2f}',
            f'{tax:.2f}',
            f'{printed_total:.2f}',
            f'{computed_total:.2f}',
            f'{difference:.2f}',
            status
        ])
        
        if status == 'discrepancy':
            print(f"DISCREPANCY FOUND in invoice {invoice_id}:")
            print(f"  Subtotal: {subtotal:.2f}")
            print(f"  Tax: {tax:.2f}")
            print(f"  Computed total: {computed_total:.2f}")
            print(f"  Printed total: {printed_total:.2f}")
            print(f"  Difference: {difference:.2f}")
            print()

print("Extraction complete. Files created: items.csv, reconciliation.csv")
EOF
", "description": "Create Python script to extract invoice data and reconcile totals"}
